roleMeanings.RATE: Material amount per specified basis; does not identify a product without material binding.
roleMeanings.DOSE: Delivered or planned amount relative to the explicitly identified treated basis.
roleMeanings.CONCENTRATION: Specified constituent amount relative to an exact mixture basis; not dose per field area.
roleMeanings.TOTAL_QUANTITY: Total specified material amount over the stated extent/time.
roleMeanings.CARRIER_VOLUME: Carrier material volume, not product amount.
roleMeanings.WATER_VOLUME: Water material volume, not irrigation depth unless separately derived.
roleMeanings.SEED_RATE: Seed count or amount per stated basis.
roleMeanings.NUTRIENT_RATE: Specified nutrient amount per basis; not fertilizer product rate.
roleMeanings.PRESSURE: Pressure at the specified equipment/process point.
roleMeanings.FLOW_RATE: Material amount per time at the specified process point.
roleMeanings.SPEED: Motion distance per time for the specified equipment/process.
roleMeanings.TIMING_INTERVAL: Duration or spacing relative to the named process phase; not the authoritative claim timestamp.
roleMeanings.APPLICATION_VOLUME: Volume of the explicitly identified applied material per the stated basis. applicationMaterialInterpretation distinguishes MIXTURE_AS_APPLIED from AS_IDENTIFIED_MATERIAL. A named water/carrier component is not total mixture volume; a product as supplied is not automatically its diluted application mixture.
roleMeanings.OTHER_PARAMETER: Requires an exact listed local role definition; no arbitrary string acquires executable meaning.

otherRoleDefinitions.DEPTH: Intervention depth as length at the stated target.
otherRoleDefinitions.MOISTURE_TARGET: Target moisture mass fraction with wet/dry basis explicitly bound.
otherRoleDefinitions.TREATED_AREA: Treated surface area, preserving partial extent.
otherRoleDefinitions.MATERIAL_HANDLED: Specified amount received, classified, disposed or established; no inventory write.

multiplicity: 0..n entries per atom; parameterId unique within atom. Role is not a unique key: multiple materials, phases, scopes, planned/actual values or conflicting source readings remain distinct entries. Never overwrite or coalesce entries by role or unit. Empty means no quantities alleged; a required profile quantity must still be present and STATED.
material: PRESENT requires materialRole and exact binding. NOT_APPLICABLE needs an explicit process quantity reason (for example equipment speed). UNREPORTED retains missing source identity and cannot satisfy a comparison requiring material identity. OTHER_MATERIAL requires an exact material definition. No role-based inference of identity.
basis: PRESENT requires quantityKind, unit, exact decimal and basis subject/material binding. Ratio basis is independent of numerator material. NOT_APPLICABLE is only for non-ratio quantities; UNREPORTED is retained but cannot satisfy a basis-dependent comparison. A wet/dry mass basis is explicit, never inferred from percent.
value: STATED stores quantityKind, unit, decimal, qualifier, unitProfile and original {presence, lexicalValue, unitText, sourceBinding, sourcePointer}; absent original lexical/unit data is explicit. Optional normalized {quantityKind, unit, decimal, conversionBinding} coexists with original; conversion must be admitted for exact material/basis. UNREPORTED stores reason and asserts no numeric value. No zero, plan substitution or silent normalization.
scope: Every entry repeats exact activityInstance and appliesTo {target, extent, subjectTime, processPoint, phase}. These must equal or explicitly be a proved subextent/time of that atom; no quantity transfers to a sibling activity. Timing intervals are parameter assertions, never a temporal-basis fallback.
comparison: Select entries by parameterId and full role/material/basis/posture/scope tuple; compare all claimed values/qualifiers with the designated source entries. A change in flow does not change product rate but does contradict the flow allegation. Compare normalized values only with the bound conversion; missing identity/basis is indeterminate, conflicting claimed value fails the chosen comparison.
fieldReferences: Row quantity fields contain only {quantityParameterId}. Resolve exactly one entry in this atom, with the row-defined role/material/posture. Standalone scalar quantity fields are not permitted in current operation bodies. Compliance operands retain their own quantity contract and may reference exact operation parameter IDs with their scope.

MIXTURE_AS_APPLIED.definition: The exact applied mixture has its own immutable identity and definition, separate from its named constituent product and carrier identities. components records each constituent materialRole and binding from that definition; no component is silently the whole mixture. At least two distinct constituent bindings are required for this mixture form.

AS_IDENTIFIED_MATERIAL.definition: The quantity applies only to this exact identified material in its declared role. PRODUCT is the identified product as supplied; WATER or CARRIER is that named component volume. OTHER_MATERIAL additionally requires its exact materialDefinition. This form does not assert the volume of a product-plus-carrier mixture.

UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_MATERIAL.definition: Retain the reported quantity and original source fields when material identity was not reported/resolved. material.presence is UNREPORTED. This is an explicit incomplete disclosure, not an assertion about an identified mixture/component and cannot satisfy a material-specific comparison.

identityRules: A positive material-specific application-volume comparison requires material presence PRESENT, exact binding and the matching interpretation; material identity cannot be erased to avoid a mismatch. UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_MATERIAL retains known numeric/source data but yields an unresolved material comparison.

MIXTURE_AS_APPLIED binding must differ from every constituent binding; the mixture definition and component roles must agree with source evidence. components is a closed list of role/binding pairs for the identified recipe/composition revision, not an unbound display label.

CARRIER_VOLUME remains a separate parameter role about the identified carrier. No role/unit coincidence proves it equals application volume, and no product-plus-carrier summation is performed without an explicit supported calculation.
UNREPORTED numeric value does not invent a material identity or mixture; any missing-material disclosure retains its unresolved comparison status.
applicationVolumeMaterialContract.sourcePreservation: The pinned SPRAY_MACHINE /actualQuantityParameters/1 is APPLICATION_VOLUME, materialRole WATER, material:water, 200 L/ha. Its faithful interpretation is AS_IDENTIFIED_MATERIAL/WATER. The separate W14 mixture example is fictional and is not a reinterpretation of those source bytes.
applicationVolumeMaterialContract.rowAlias: O01.parameters.applicationVolume resolves its same-atom quantityParameterId, requires APPLICATION_VOLUME and then this discriminated material contract. It has no fixed CARRIER-only constraint.
